aboutGame.title: What is Rat Lab?
paragraphs: Rat Lab is an immersive Roblox puzzle and escape adventure where players take on the roles of lab subjects navigating dangerous research facilities. Developed by Evil Science, the game challenges you to outsmart automated testing chambers, bypass security protocols, and uncover the mysteries hidden within the laboratory complex.

Whether you are mastering spatial puzzle mechanics, experimenting with genetic mutations, or collaborating with teammates to trigger emergency exits, our wiki provides complete walkthroughs, task checklists, and progression strategies for every player.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Rat Lab.

items.question: What is Rat Lab?
items.answer: Rat Lab is a Roblox puzzle and escape game developed by Evil Science where players navigate hazardous testing chambers, master mutation mechanics, and attempt to escape a top-secret research facility.

items.question: How do I escape the laboratory in Rat Lab?
items.answer: To escape in Rat Lab, players must survey chamber layouts, solve spatial and electrical puzzles, coordinate with teammates to press switches, and unlock secure exit doors before security intercepts them.

items.question: What are mutations in Rat Lab?
items.answer: Mutations in Rat Lab are experimental biological enhancements that provide special perks such as increased movement speed, enhanced jump height, acid resistance, and quicker conduit interactions.

items.question: Are there active codes for Rat Lab?
items.answer: Rat Lab codes can be released by the developers during milestones or major updates. Check our codes section regularly for the latest active rewards and redemption instructions.

items.question: Can you play Rat Lab solo or with friends?
items.answer: Rat Lab supports both solo puzzle solving and cooperative multiplayer. Teaming up with friends makes coordinating multi-switch doors and complex escape routes significantly easier.
